sendVerificationSecureSms:
mutation sendVerificationSecureSms(
	$phoneDialCode: String!
	$phoneNumber: String!
	$deviceId: String!
	$deviceType: String!
	$userType: Int,
	$securityKey: String!
) {
	sendVerificationSecureSms(
		phoneDialCode: $phoneDialCode
		phoneNumber: $phoneNumber
		deviceId: $deviceId
		deviceType: $deviceType
		userType: $userType,
		securityKey: $securityKey
	) {
		status
		errorMessage
		phoneNumber
		phoneDialCode
	}
}
signup_mutation:
mutation (
    $firstName: String, 
    $lastName: String, 
    $email: String!, 
    $password: String!, 
    $phoneDialCode: String!,
    $phoneCountryCode: String!,
    $phoneNumber: String!,
    $lat: Float,
    $lng: Float,
    $city: String,
    $state:String,
    $zipcode: String,
    $country: String,
    $vehicleName: String,
    $vehicleType: Int,
    $vehicleNumber: String,
    $userType: Int!,
    $deviceType: String!,
    $deviceId: String!,
    $preferredLanguage: String
,
    $gender: String
) {
    createUser (
        firstName: $firstName, 
        lastName: $lastName, 
        email: $email, 
        password: $password,
        phoneDialCode: $phoneDialCode,
       phoneCountryCode: $phoneCountryCode,
        phoneNumber: $phoneNumber,
        lat: $lat,
        lng: $lng,
        city: $city,
        state: $state,
        zipcode: $zipcode,
        country: $country,
        vehicleName: $vehicleName,
        vehicleType: $vehicleType,
        vehicleNumber: $vehicleNumber,
        userType: $userType,
        deviceType: $deviceType,
        deviceId: $deviceId,
     preferredLanguage: $preferredLanguage,
     gender: $gender) {
        result {
            userId
            userToken
email
phoneNumber
            user {
              firstName
              lastName
              
              preferredLanguage
              preferredCurrency
              status
              country
              createdAt
            gender
            }
           }
      status
            errorMessage
    }
}

createScheduleBookingMutation:
mutation createScheduleBooking(
    $riderLocation: String!,
    $riderLocationLat: Float!,
    $riderLocationLng: Float!,
    $pickUpLocation: String!,
    $pickUpLat: Float!,
    $pickUpLng: Float!,
    $dropOffLocation: String!,
    $dropOffLat: Float!,
    $dropOffLng: Float!,
    $rideDistance: Float!,
    $rideDuration: Float!,
    $category: Int!,
    $deviceId: String!,
    $deviceType: String!,
    $promoId: Int,
    $paymentType: Int!,
    $scheduleFrom: Int!,
    $scheduleTo: Int!,
    $distanceType: String,

  $comfortRide: [Int] 
 $dateValue: String, 
 $dayValue: String, 
 $startTimeValue: String) {
    createScheduleBooking (
        riderLocation: $riderLocation,
        riderLocationLat: $riderLocationLat,
        riderLocationLng: $riderLocationLng,
        pickUpLocation: $pickUpLocation,
        pickUpLat: $pickUpLat,
        pickUpLng: $pickUpLng,
        dropOffLocation: $dropOffLocation,
        dropOffLat: $dropOffLat,
        dropOffLng: $dropOffLng,
        rideDistance: $rideDistance,
        rideDuration: $rideDuration,
        category: $category,
        deviceId: $deviceId,
        deviceType: $deviceType,
        promoId: $promoId,
        paymentType: $paymentType,
        scheduleFrom: $scheduleFrom,
        scheduleTo: $scheduleTo,
        distanceType: $distanceType
   comfortRide: $comfortRide
 dateValue: $dateValue
  dayValue: $dayValue
  startTimeValue: $startTimeValue) {
        status
        errorMessage
        result {
            bookingId
        }
    }
}
